smstunnel.description: Send texts (SMS) and sign-in codes from your own Android phone and your own number, check whether they went out, and read replies. Free plan: 25 texts a day and 500 a month; paid plans from $9 a month. SMSTunnel charges no per-text fee: each text goes out from your phone's SIM at your mobile plan's rates. Needs Node.js 20 or newer, the SMSTunnel app from Google Play on the phone, and SMSTUNNEL_API_KEY set in your environment (a key from dashboard.smstunnel.io: Apps → Add an app).
